title: The sandbox image carries no strace, so tracing a failing tool inside a sandbox starts with a package install
foundBy: owner's request, 2026-11-16: "bundle strace in the sandbox images", after a gVisor investigation had to install it
details:
The shipped image has `lsof`, `tcpdump` and `htop`, and no `strace`. Tracing which `mount(2)` a nested podman makes under gVisor needed one, and got it with `sudo dnf install strace`. Inside a gVisor sandbox that install is gone after the next start, because the root filesystem starts fresh there. An agent debugging a tool in a sandbox meets the same gap.

The package belongs in the base tier's package list in `image/Containerfile.base`. The image pulls that tier at the tag `image/tiers.env` pins. The change therefore reaches an image only once the weekly base build publishes it and somebody pins the result.

notes.text: Commit 2a3ec9b adds `strace` to the base tier's one dnf transaction, beside `lsof`. In a throwaway `registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44` container, which is that tier's base, `dnf install --setopt=install_weak_deps=False strace` exited 0, and `strace -V` printed version 7.3. No image carries it yet, so this stays open until a base tier with it is published and `image/tiers.env` pins it. The slim image is unchanged, because its package list is what a sandbox needs to boot.
